fields.value: Supporting Materials for Characterising the Alteration in the AP Distribution with the RSS Distance and the Position Estimates

dsDescriptionValue.value: This package includes the supporting materials to reproduce the results shown in the paper "Characterising the Alteration in the AP Distribution with the RSS Distance and the Position Estimates" accepted in the Ninth International Conference on Indoor Positioning and Indoor Navigation (IPIN 2018). Citation policy The associated package is to be cited as follows: Torres-Sospedra, J.; Richter, P.; Mendoza-Silva, G.M.; Lohan, E.S.; and Huerta, J. Characterising the Alteration in the AP Distribution with the RSS Distance and the Position Estimates. Proceedings of the Ninth International Conference on Indoor Positioning and Indoor Navigation, 2018. Torres-Sospedra, J.; Richter, P.; Mendoza-Silva, G.M.; Lohan, E.S.; and Huerta, J. Supporting Materials for Characterising the Alteration in the AP Distribution with the RSS Distance and the Position Estimates, Zenodo repository, 2018. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1305414 Additional Citations In addition to the package citations, you should also include a cite to the original datasets sources. The simdb dataset included in this package is also to be cited as follows: Torres-Sospedra, J. and Moreira, A. Analysis of sources of large positioning errors in deterministic fingerprinting Sensors Vol. 17(12), 2017. https://doi.org/10.3390/s17122736 The libdb instances used in this package are also to be cited as follows: Mendoza-Silva, G.; Richter, P.; Torres-Sospedra, J.; Lohan, E.S.; Huerta, J. Long-Term WiFi Fingerprinting Dataset for Research on Robust Indoor Positioning, Data Vol. 3(1), 2018. https://doi.org/10.3390/data3010003 Mendoza-Silva, G.M.; Richter, P.; Torres-Sospedra, J.; Lohan, E.S. and J. Huerta, "Long-Term Wi-Fi fingerprinting dataset and supporting material", Zenodo repository, 2018. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1066041. The mandb instances (reduced versions) are also to be cited as follows: Thomas King, Stephan Kopf, Thomas Haenselmann, Christian Lubberger, Wolfgang Effelsberg, CRAWDAD dataset mannheim/compass (v. 2008‑04‑11), traceset: fingerprint, downloaded from https://crawdad.org/mannheim/compass/20080411/fingerprint Changes log Update 201807011 Added missing file mainAnalysis/datarep_remapBldDB.m Comments have been improced Minor changes commenting/removing unnecessary code
